parole.significato: to board (forceful entry onto a vessel)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Gallo-Italic, compare Piedmontese arambése (“to approach”) and Ligurian arembà, arembar (“to place, put; to rely”), the latter also borrowed into Corsican arrimbà (“to place, put”). Further etymology uncertain.
Borrowed from Gallo-Italic, compare Piedmontese àmpola, Lombard ampon, Venetan ampoma, ampómola, with the initial l- by concretion of the definite article.
Borrowed from Gallo-Italic, likely Piedmontese [Term?]. Doublet of reticella.

parole.significato: cliff, rock (in the sea); a reef
parole.testo: Possibly borrowed from a Gallo-Italic descendant of Vulgar Latin *scoculum, from Classical Latin scopulus, from Ancient Greek. Cognate with French écueil.
